gloss: even more, all the more, noticeably

definitions.gloss: even more, all the more, noticeably
definitions.explanation: Indicates that something has increased or improved by a noticeable degree compared to before. Emphasizes a step up from a previous level.

examples.japanese: {秋|あき}になって{一段|いちだん}と{寒|さむ}くなった。
examples.english: It got noticeably colder when autumn arrived.

examples.japanese: {練習|れんしゅう}の{成果|せいか}で{一段|いちだん}と{上手|じょうず}になった。
examples.english: Thanks to practice, she became even more skillful.

examples.japanese: ライトアップされた{紅葉|こうよう}は{一段|いちだん}と{美|うつく}しかった。
examples.english: The illuminated autumn leaves were all the more beautiful.

notes:
USAGE NOTES:
{一段|いちだん}と means "by one step more" and is used to describe a noticeable increase or improvement. It typically modifies adjectives or verbs expressing change.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- さらに: furthermore, even more (neutral, can be used in lists)
- ますます: more and more, increasingly (emphasizes ongoing progression)
- いっそう: all the more, even more (slightly more formal)
